name: 37902 · Knoxville, TN
findings: ZIP 37902 (Knoxville) has 102 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37902 (Knoxville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 37902 (Knoxville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 12.6 times the typical level).
